engine.notes: Neighborhood Comedy Theatre's domain has lapsed into a parking page and should be marked closed; no successor site was found. JesterZ Improv Comedy (Gilbert) is confirmed live and is now the only verified active organisation for this metro. Two other Neighborhood Comedy Theatre moved domain to nctphoenix.com; verified live 2026-10-02.

entries.name: JesterZ Improv Comedy
entries.summary: A family-friendly, alcohol-free improv theatre in downtown Gilbert running weekend shows and an eight-week adult class ladder with an audition-gated path to the main stage.
entries.schedule: Shows Friday and Saturday at 6:30 and 8:30 PM; new class sessions start roughly every two months
signals: Serving the Phoenix area for over two decades
Four adult class levels ending in an audition for Rising Stars performance
2026 session start dates published (Jan, Mar, May, Jul, Sep)
entries.reasons: A well-established, alcohol-free improv theatre with a clear beginner-to-stage class path and a current, specific 2026 schedule.

entries.name: The Neighborhood Comedy Theatre
entries.summary: A long-running improv comedy theatre in historic downtown Mesa, running improv shows through the week and a class programme for adults and teens.
entries.schedule: Shows most weekends; classes in terms
signals: Improv classes for adults and teens
entries.reasons: Its own venue, a regular show calendar and a class ladder; the valley's steadiest improv room.
